name: recordings_get_speaker_evidence
title: Get recording speaker evidence
description: Reads the first-class speaker evidence for a recording. Returns one row per diarized speaker track, profile bindings, confirmation state, voiceprint/transcript/visual evidence, roles, bounded source-time subject geometry when a current evidence generation exists, summary counts, and a compact model context. Geometry is evidence, never an already-chosen crop or title placement.

decision_id.description: Optional saved identity answer on this Recording. Returns its support and current withdrawal scope.

speaker_map_id.description: Alternatively, the answer on this exact voice, including an older human confirmation.

identity_answer.description: Selected answer, accessible source evidence, human dependency and withdrawal scope fingerprint.
